title: Intro to Computer Science — Mission 1: The Broken Script
description: The robotics club's sorting script is misbehaving right before the demo. You have one debugging session to fix the logic before the judges arrive.

iris.name: Iris Chen
iris.description: Can trace through a loop in her head faster than most people can read it.

ben.name: Ben
ben.description: Thinks debugging means deleting code until it stops complaining.

debugger.name: Debugger Console
debugger.description: Lets you step through the script line by line.

code_printout.name: Code Printout
code_printout.description: A paper copy of the sorting script's current logic.

elements.text: The sorting script keeps putting items in the wrong bin. Before we touch anything, let's trace what the loop is actually doing.
I already deleted the part that looked wrong. It still doesn't work.

options.text: "Let's get the printout and trace through the variables step by step."
"Just keep deleting lines until the errors stop."

elements.text: Good, you grabbed the printout. Let's trace the loop's logic properly.
Deleting lines at random just removes working code. We need to trace it, not guess.

config.question: A loop is written as: for i in range(0, 5): print(i). How many times does it print, and what is the last value printed?
config.explanation: range(0, 5) produces 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 — five values, stopping before 5, so the last printed value is 4.

config.prompt: Order these debugging steps from first to last.

items.text: Trace variable values through the code
Form a hypothesis about the cause

config.prompt: Ben: "What's the algorithm called that repeatedly steps through a list, swapping adjacent items that are out of order? Two words."

elements.text: The loop's fixed and the sorting works correctly. We're ready for the judges.
It sorts, mostly. Next time, trace the logic before deleting anything.

elements.prompt: The script runs clean. What now?

options.text: Walk Ben through tracing loops and variables so he can debug independently.
Log off. The script works, that's enough for today.

elements.text: So debugging isn't deleting things and hoping — it's actually tracing what the code does. Noted.

ending.title: Debugging Hero
ending.description: Fixed the sorting script and taught the club how to trace and debug code properly.

ending.title: Script Runs
ending.description: The demo works. The deeper lesson can wait until tomorrow.
